title: Irresistible: Alcaraz finally conquers Paris and gets his US Open revenge on Shelton
snippet: Carlos Alcaraz beat Ben Shelton 7-6 (5), 7-5 to win the Rolex Paris Masters for the first time, a week after his title in Vienna, and avenged his US Open quarter-final defeat.

title: Lansere comes from a set down to beat top seed Blinkova for Luanda title
snippet: Eighth seed Sofya Lansere beat France's Anna Blinkova 5-7, 6-1, 6-4 in the Angola Ladies Open final on Sunday, after letting a 5-2 lead slip in the opening set. The Russian, ranked No. 266, dropped only that set all week.
